verses.ar:
Ya Mustafa Noor ul Huda Saani Tera Koi Nahiñ
Shams-ud-duha Koi Nahi Badr-ud-duja Koi Nahi
verses.en:
O Mustafa, Light of Guidance — there is no equal to you
Sun of the morning — there is none; Moon of darkness — there is none

verses.ar:
Karam Jab Aal-e Nabi Ka Shareek Hota Hai
Bigad Bigad Ke Har Ek Kaam Dheek Hota Hai
verses.en:
When one is blessed to belong to the Prophet's family
Every failing matter is set right

verses.ar:
Har Nafas Ishq-e Muhammad Ka Payaami Kar Lo
Zindagi Mit Ke Mohabbat Mein Dawaami Karlo
verses.en:
Make every breath a messenger of the love of Muhammad
Evanesce your life in devotion to his affection in perpetuity

verses.ar:
BaadShaahi Hai Agar Dono Jahañ Ki Darkaar
Dosto Aao Mohammad Ki Ghulami Kar Lo
verses.en:
If you desire to rule both the worlds
Come and devote yourselves to the service of Muhammad first

verses.ar:
Allah Ki Ham JalwaGari Dekh Rahe Haiñ
Ya Husn o Jamaal-e Madani Dekh Rahe Haiñ
verses.en:
Are we witnessing the splendour of Allah's creations
Or admiring the charm and elegance of the Medina-dweller?

verses.ar:
Jis Waqt Padho Salle-ala Aal-e Muhammad
Samjho Ke Rasool-e Arabi Dekh Rahe Haiñ
verses.en:
The moment you recite salutations, O family of Muhammad
Understand — the Prophet of the Arabs is beholding you

verses.ar:
Hadd-e Tauseef Se Bhi Naam Hai Baala Tera
Ke Khuda Aap Hai Khud Chaahne Waala Tera
verses.en:
Your exaltation knows no bounds
For God Himself loves you fervently

verses.ar:
Tere Sadqe Hui Manzoor Duaa-e Aadam
Roz-e Awwal Hi Tha Maujood Ujala Tera
verses.en:
It is for your sake that Adam's supplication was accepted
Your brilliance was present from the commencement of the universe

verses.ar:
Kaali Kamli Waale Aaqa
Saani Tera Koi Nahiñ
Rasool Aur Bhi Aaye Jahaan Mein, Lekin
Kaali Kamli Waale Aaqa
Saani Tera Koi Nahiñ
verses.en:
O Master of the black shawl
There is no equal to you
Other Prophets also came to this world — but
O Master of the black shawl
There is truly no equal to you

verses.ar:
Shah-e Yasrabi Tere Husn Ki
Kise Taab Jo Kare Hamsari
Na Guloñ Meiñ Aisi Shuguftgi
Na Ye Rango Boo Na Ye Saadgi
Ye Anokhi Chhab Ye Nayi Phaban
Ye Adaaeñ Pyaari Ye Saadgi
Teri Misl Koi Hua Na Ho
Tere Sadqe Jaauñ Maiñ Ya Nabi
verses.en:
O King of Yasrib (Medina) — who has the capacity to rival your beauty?
No flower blooms with such radiance
None has such colour, fragrance and simplicity
This unique grace, this fresh beauty
These endearing manners, this simplicity
There has never been nor will be anyone like you
I sacrifice myself for you, O Prophet

verses.ar:
Har-Har Kundal-Kundal Utte Aashiq Da Dil Dole
Husn Tere Di Sift Ki Aakhaañ Kaafir Kalma Bole
verses.en:
On every lock of your hair the lover's heart sways
In praise of your beauty even the disbeliever utters the Kalima

verses.ar:
Phire Zamaane Meiñ Chaar Janib
Nigaar-e Yakta Tumhi Ko Dekha
Haseen Dekhe Jameel Dekhe
Par Ek Tumsa Tumhi Ko Dekha
verses.en:
Searching in every direction through the ages
The peerless one — I have seen only you
I have seen the beautiful, I have seen the handsome
But one like you — only you have I seen

verses.ar:
Hue Haiñ Hazrat-e Yusuf Haseeñ Zamaane Meiñ
Magar Unheiñ Bhi Tere Husn Ki Zaqaat Mili
verses.en:
Sayyiduna Yusuf was beautiful in his age
Yet even he received but a fraction (zakat) of your beauty

verses.ar:
Khatm-e Rusul Khair-ul Amal Koi Nahi Tera Badal
Aayeena-e Husn-e Azal Tere Siwa Koi Nahiñ
verses.en:
The seal of prophets, no one can take your place in righteous deeds
In the mirror of eternal beauty, there's no one else but you

verses.ar:
Jaayeñ Kahañ Ham Be-Nawa Aaqa Tere Dar Ke Siwa
Ham BeKasoñ Ka Aasra Ya Mustafa Koi Nahiñ
verses.en:
Where can we — the poor ones — go except to your door?
O Chosen One, we the helpless have no refuge except you

verses.ar:
Ai Mazhar-e Noor-e Khuda Tum Sa Kahañ Hai Doosra
Tum Ho Imaam-ul Ambiya Tum Sa Hua Koi Nahiñ
verses.en:
O manifestation of God's Light, where is anyone like you?
You're the leader of all prophets, there's no one else like you
